correctness.rationale: For 3∤N, two positive-contact multipliers prove a sharp normalized cosine bound and force two zeros; the odd Fourier samples then force both sine coefficients to vanish. Exact checker corroborates orders 5..300 but is not substituted for the unrestricted proof.
